description: Issue a new API key for this client only. Your other clients keep their keys. The old key keeps working for 10 minutes (so a retry after a lost response can recover) and then stops; store the new one, it is shown only once and this call is never replayed.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string you make up for this action, 8-128 characters (a UUID works). Reuse the same key only to retry this exact call.

name: rotate_api_key
title: Rotate API key
